pack.title: Condescending strangers
pack.description: Unsolicited superiority from people you'll never see again. Brief and gone.

scenarios.setting: Bookstore. You ask where the new releases are; the clerk sighs audibly.
scenarios.jab: It's literally signed everywhere. Just look around.

replies.line: Please point me toward the new releases.
replies.why: It restates the practical request without commenting on the attitude.
replies.delivery: Ask for the exact section calmly; if help is refused, turn to another staff member.

replies.why: Two words that skip the attitude and collect the answer.
replies.delivery: Ask for the exact section calmly; if help is refused, turn to another staff member.

replies.line: I haven't found the section yet; could you point me toward it?
replies.why: It explains the need briefly and asks for specific assistance.
replies.delivery: Ask for the exact section calmly; if help is refused, turn to another staff member.

replies.line: The books are winning hide-and-seek; where are the new releases?
replies.why: The joke targets finding the section rather than the staff member or a medical condition.
replies.delivery: Ask for the exact section calmly; if help is refused, turn to another staff member.

trap.line: Let me speak to your manager about your attitude.
trap.why: It replaces a specific request with accusation, resentment, or an excuse, making your actual boundary less clear.

scenarios.goal: Get directions without joining a rude exchange.

followUp.jab: I already told you to look around.
followUp.line: I'll ask someone else, then. Thank you.
followUp.why: It ends an unhelpful interaction and preserves your ability to get assistance elsewhere.
followUp.delivery: Ask for the exact section calmly; if help is refused, turn to another staff member.

scenarios.setting: Gym. You rerack your weights; a stranger watches, arms crossed.
scenarios.jab: You know that's not how you do that exercise, right?

replies.line: Thanks. I'll check my technique with a qualified trainer.
replies.why: It acknowledges possible safety concerns while choosing an appropriate source of advice.
replies.delivery: Keep “thanks” genuine; pause the exercise if you are uncertain about safety.

replies.why: It declines the lesson before it's offered, with thanks as the full stop.
replies.delivery: Keep “thanks” genuine; pause the exercise if you are uncertain about safety.

replies.line: Thanks for the concern; I'll check with a trainer before continuing if I'm unsure.
replies.why: It treats safety seriously without committing to an unsolicited lesson.
replies.delivery: Keep “thanks” genuine; pause the exercise if you are uncertain about safety.

replies.line: My technique can wait for a qualified review.
replies.why: The light phrasing postpones the debate rather than encouraging unsafe exercise.
replies.delivery: Keep “My technique can wait for a qualified review” light; let the joke stand without repeating it. Pause the exercise if you are uncertain about safety.

scenarios.goal: Decline unsolicited coaching without dismissing safety.

followUp.line: Thanks for the concern; I'll check with a qualified trainer.
followUp.why: It accepts that safety may matter without submitting to an unsolicited lesson.
followUp.delivery: Keep “thanks” genuine; pause the exercise if you are uncertain about safety.

scenarios.setting: A person at a ticket machine laughs when you ask how it works.
scenarios.goal: Ask for help without defending your competence.

replies.line: I'm asking which button buys a return ticket.
replies.why: It returns to the exact information needed instead of debating your ability.
replies.delivery: Keep the question level; if they remain unhelpful, turn away and seek staff.

replies.why: It removes the commentary and keeps the practical question.
replies.delivery: Keep the question level; if they remain unhelpful, turn away and seek staff.

replies.line: I haven't used this machine before; could you point out the return option?
replies.why: It gives brief context and a specific request for assistance.
replies.delivery: Keep the question level; if they remain unhelpful, turn away and seek staff.

replies.line: My first round with this machine; where's the return button?
replies.why: Humor about your unfamiliarity keeps the request clear without accepting an insult.
replies.delivery: Keep the question level; if they remain unhelpful, turn away and seek staff.

followUp.line: I'll ask the attendant, then. Thanks.
followUp.why: It ends an unhelpful exchange and moves toward another source of help.
followUp.delivery: Keep the question level; if they remain unhelpful, turn away and seek staff.
